message.content: {"caption":"A text-panel screenshot showing a memory-retrieval prompt, selected memories for John and Maria, and the question about whether John lives near a beach or mountains.","description":"A light-gray rectangular panel with a thin border and a darker title bar reading “Full Prompt and Retrieved Memories.” Monospaced black text is arranged in sections. The opening says the assistant retrieves accurate information from conversation memories. “CONTEXT” says it has timestamped memories from two speakers that may help answer a question. “INSTRUCTIONS” contains ten numbered directions: analyze both speakers’ memories and timestamps; seek direct evidence; prioritize the most recent memory if there is a contradiction; resolve relative dates; use only the memories and avoid mixing up names; keep the answer concise; output useful memories before the answer; and mark the final answer with “Answer:”. “APPROACH (Think step by step)” lists eight steps, including examining relevant memories and timestamps, checking for explicit evidence, converting relative references, drafting and checking a specific concise answer, and outputting important memories first. Under “Memories for user John,” three entries are visible: at 7:20 pm on 16 June 2023, John recalls a California vacation with a gorgeous sunset and an enjoyable shoreline stroll with loved ones; at 6:13 pm on 10 April 2023, he explored the Pacific Northwest coast and some national parks; and at 3:14 pm on 13 August 2023, he is described as enjoying outdoor family activities such as hiking, parks, and picnics, as well as board games and movie nights at home. Under “Memories for user Maria,” three entries are visible: at 6:29 pm on 7 July 2023, a memory says John experienced a severe flood in his old area the previous week, damaging homes because of poor infrastructure; at 1:24 pm on 25 May 2023, Maria appreciates small meaningful moments, as reflected in her reaction to a family beach photo John shared; and at 3:14 pm on 13 August 2023, she appreciates family bonding and is interested in activities John and his family enjoy. Each memory section says that 30 most relevant memories are provided in total. The final line asks, “Does John live close to a beach or the mountains?” No arrows, symbols, or chart elements are present.","figure_type":"screenshot","chart_values":[]}
